title: ADJ Blocks
description: Adds some decorative blocks that generate in the world and backports most 1.21.5 blocks.
body:
Made specifically for my upcoming modpack `A Distant Journey`. But you are **UNCONDITIONALLY FREE** to include it in yours ^^.

------

ADJ Blocks re-adds **Cattails** and **Duckweed** from older versions of the [Naturalist](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/naturalist) mod and ports over **Twigs**, **Pebbles** and **Azalea Flowers** from the [Twigs](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/twigs) mod. It also ports most blocks from the 1.21.5 **Spring To Life** update (everything except Firefly Bushes and Cactus Flowers). It also adds red and blue variants of Wildflowers and a Cherry variant of Leaf Litter.

Every block generates naturally in the world and is 100% functional and obtainable in Survival.

## Why port over rather than use the mods themselves?

Naturalist removed their worldgen features a while back ago, meaning I'd have stay on na older version which doesn't have modern features nor bugfixes. On the other hand, Twigs adds a ton of overlapping content with other mods in my modpack. I opted in for porting them over to my own mod rather than using a mod like ItemObliterator to disable all of them as it would still keep them in the memory, bloating the RAM usage.

This mod reuses some code bits of both of those mods (both of which licensed its code under the MIT license), **but it doesn't reuse their assets**. The texture's for the blocks were done by me (and a lovely contributor - Midas - from my Discord server).

**Spring To Life** textures are owned by Mojang. I take 0 credit for those.
